dialect.detail: JMA ORCA (Japan Medical Association standard receipt software) - uses GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL with 'grpsys' tagged lines for conditional compilation, CALL to ORCDBMAIN for database operations

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt (claims) processing system - order editing subprogram
purpose.summary: This subprogram handles deletion of order records and order item records in the ORCA medical receipt system. It fetches order items by key, rebuilds the item list into a linkage section array, then deletes both the order and order-item records from the database via ORCDBMAIN calls.

notable_features: grpsys conditional-compilation tag pattern used throughout
CALL to ORCDBMAIN for all DB operations (SELECT, FETCH, CLOSECURSOR, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE)
Heavy use of COPY statements for record layouts (CPORDER.INC, CPODRITEM.INC, MCPDATA.INC, MCPAREA, CPORCSODR.INC, CPORCSODRS01.INC)
LINKAGE SECTION with OCCURS for order item array
Japanese comments encoded in latin-1 (Shift-JIS/EUC-JP garbled)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary ORCDBMAIN abstraction layer
PERFORM UNTIL loop for cursor fetch pattern
verdict.notes: Comments contain Japanese text that appears garbled due to latin-1 decoding of what is likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS encoding. The 'grpsys' prefix on certain lines appears to be a conditional compilation or source-tagging mechanism specific to the ORCA build system. The file is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt software project.
